summary: Apply the construction of Poincaré series as forms (exists_form_eq_tsum) to each cutBessel(a, ·), whose Γ-sum is regrouped through Γ ≅ (Γ/𝖴_c(g)) × 𝖴_c(g); the resulting forms are the Poincaré series since cutBessel is already fixed by the type kernel; extend linearly in φ.

steps.claim: Take the bounds M_a of tsum_cutBessel_le.
For each a choose a form y_a of type typeKernel(l, ε) and level stdPrincipalLevel(S) with y_a(g) = Σ_{γ∈Γ} cutBessel(a, γg):
steps.lean:
choose y e using fun a ↦ let o := (cosetProdEquiv (S.classUnip a.1)).trans X.ratEquiv.1
    have e g := (o.tsum_eq (X.cutBessel a <| · * g)).symm.trans
      (o.summable_iff.2 (.of_enorm ((h a g).trans_lt (by simp)).ne)).tsum_prod
    (V.exists_form_eq_tsum (ι := Quotient _) X.3 S.stdPrincipalLevel (by fun_prop)
      (by simp_all [cutBessel, ← mul_assoc, mul_mem_cancel_right]) e (by simp) (h a · |>.trans' (by
      grw [← o.tsum_eq, ENNReal.tsum_prod', enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm]; rfl))).imp fun _ h g ↦
      (e g).trans (.symm (congr($h g).trans (tsum_congr fun _ ↦ by
      simp [o, tsum_cutBessel_classUnip, realConv, besselFn]
      rw [← funext (X.1 · |>.3 ..), ← integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod]
      split <;> simp [realHomeo]; rfl)))

steps.claim: regroup the sum over Γ ≅ (Γ/𝖴_c(g)) × 𝖴_c(g) (summable by the bound);
steps.lean:
have e g := (o.tsum_eq (X.cutBessel a <| · * g)).symm.trans
      (o.summable_iff.2 (.of_enorm ((h a g).trans_lt (by simp)).ne)).tsum_prod

steps.claim: exists_form_eq_tsum with the idempotent kernel (X.3), the open level, measurability, the level property of cutBessel, the regrouped sum and the bound give a form equal to Σ_q R(e)W_q,
steps.lean:
(V.exists_form_eq_tsum (ι := Quotient _) X.3 S.stdPrincipalLevel (by fun_prop)
      (by simp_all [cutBessel, ← mul_assoc, mul_mem_cancel_right]) e (by simp) (h a · |>.trans' (by
      grw [← o.tsum_eq, ENNReal.tsum_prod', enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm]; rfl)))

steps.claim: and each R(e)W_q equals W_q: the inner sums over 𝖴_c(g) are Bessel functions (tsum_cutBessel_classUnip) fixed by the type kernel (kernel_fix of IsBessel).
steps.lean:
.imp fun _ h g ↦
      (e g).trans (.symm (congr($h g).trans (tsum_congr fun _ ↦ by
      simp [o, tsum_cutBessel_classUnip, realConv, besselFn]
      rw [← funext (X.1 · |>.3 ..), ← integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod]
      split <;> simp [realHomeo]; rfl)))

steps.claim: Q = the linear extension of a ↦ y_a.
Q(φ) = Σ_a φ_a y_a = poincare(X, φ, Γ, ·).
